content: .{@-पुरम्@} .²1 a collection of three cities. .²2 the three cities of gold, silver, and iron in the sky, air and earth built for demons by Maya; (these cities were burnt down, along the demons inhabiting them, by Śiva at the request of the gods); <ls>Ku. 7. 48</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 2</ls>; संरक्ताभिस्त्रिपुरविजयो गीयते किन्नरीभिः <ls>Me. 56</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 123</ls>; . ({@-रः@}) <ab>N.</ab> of a demon or demons presiding over these cities. ({@-री@}) .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a place near Jabalpura, formerly capital of the kings of Chedi. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a country.
